executionRequirements: One fresh canonical workspace per case; seed only through ordinary services.
Explicit source selection and live captured page/body title identities; no source-text-derived permissions.
Prepare/capture using GeneratePersonalReview production path, native actual tokenizer and unchanged review grammar.
Exactly one native generation per case; no hidden retry or answer reconstruction.
Retain raw draft, prepared/actual generator controls, displayed draft/citations, source/revisions and before/after canonical audit.
Run all4 in declared order; no case filtering for an overall claim.
Independent goldens/poisons/scope validation before native execution.
No proposed source/body changes or approved application during this comparison.
Any faithful semantic alternative outside exact requested form is recorded separately with original automated grade preserved.
